headline: Built to extend
body: One render loop, one owner per property, WebGPU with a WebGL2 fallback, a no-WebGL poster, reduced-motion support, and a documented uniform contract. The shader, motion, UI, and audit agents build on top from here.
footnote: Demo composed from registry blueprints 01 · 02 · 03 · 05 · 06 · 07 · 09 · 11 · 12 — factory pipeline, stage S5.
